title: The government can take 15% of Social Security benefits to repay student loans. These proposals seek to stop it.
summary: The federal government can offset Social Security benefits to recover student loan debt, and lawmakers are proposing legislation to prevent this practice. As debt burdens among older Americans continue to rise, these proposals aim to protect retirement income from reduction for debt repayment.
content: Debt among older Americans is rising, both in terms of the number of older households carrying debt and the amount borrowed.

zh.title: 政府可以扣押15%的社会保障福利来偿还学生贷款。这些提案旨在阻止这一做法。
zh.summary: 联邦政府可以抵消社会保障福利以收回学生贷款债务，议员们正在提议立法来防止这种做法。随着年长美国人的债务负担继续上升，这些提案旨在保护退休收入免受债务偿还的缩减。
